items.title: Freeness criterion over a complete Noetherian ring via Mittag-Leffler and universal injectivity
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a freeness criterion over a complete Noetherian ring: under a condition on the associated primes of the fibres, a flat finite module whose reduction modulo the ideal is projective is projective over the base (statement lines 2144-2161, tag 05FY-adjacent). The proof uses universal injectivity of the map into the completion and the Mittag-Leffler property of the completion to conclude that the module is Mittag-Leffler as a pure submodule, and then applies the criterion for a countably generated flat Mittag-Leffler module to be projective. The purity argument is the substance, so the claim is H2.
